name: Kamisato Ayato
notes: Both sources: ATK% sands (ER as a second option), Hydro DMG goblet, CRIT circlet, Haran Geppaku Futsu first, Skill > Burst > Normal Attack. The best set depends on his playstyle: Game8 gives Echoes of an Offering (low-ping), Heart of Depth and Emblem of Severed Fate (sub-DPS); KQM lists Heart of Depth, Gladiator's Finale, Nymph's Dream and Echoes first. Goals are Game8's: ATK 2,000, CRIT Rate 70-80 (75), CRIT DMG 160, ER 100-130 (130 used; KQM solo Hydro 130-160, double Hydro 120-135). His damage is the Shunsuiken, which sits under his Skill and uses the physical curve (1.98x at level 10) while dealing Hydro DMG; the kit's 'check' lines for it scale with ATK (Namisen's bonus is the Max HP part, hence HP% as a minor weight).
